newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moulinex returns to profit in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Moulinex returns to profit in 1996/97.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - Appliance manufacturer Moulinex gave its 1996/97 results in a statement.

It said the annual profit, the first since 1991, was achieved despite a 0.5 percent drop in sales, lower production in the second half to reduce inventories and disruption caused by a restructuring entailing job cuts and two plant closures.
Lower raw materials prices and foreign exchange shifts had a positive effect on results, as did the first benefits of a three-year restructuring plan presented a year ago.
Consolidated net debt was 1,108 million francs against 1,508 million.

After a 525 million franc capital increase, Moulinex's debt-to-equity ratio was 0.8 on March 31. It said it also planned the launch soon of a five-year bond issue to be quoted on the Paris and Luxembourg stockmarkets.
